methods.name: Generalized synthetic control: interactive fixed effects (Xu 2017), LOO cross-validation, matrix completion, bootstrap
methods.reference: gsynth::gsynth 1.4.0 (estimator 'gsynth' | 'mc') = fect::fect 2.4.5 (method 'gsynth' | 'mc', cv.method 'loo'); written-out IFE, MC, LOO and deterministic-fold MC CV and both bootstraps (gsynth's own draws replayed) checked against them in validation/r/cases/causal_gsynth.R
quantities: LOO CV MSPE by r and selected r
MC: ATT, beta, rank, lambda grid, CV MSPE by lambda, selected lambda
bootstrap replicates, SE, normal CI, p, event-time SEs (replayed draws)
methods.tolerance: n = 1500 / 720 cells: closed-form fits (no covariates) at validation/README.md (coefficients 1e-10 / 1e-8, statistics 1e-8 / 1e-6 relative); iterative fits pinned at tolerance 1e-12 to the tight references at Tol::iterative(1e-8) (IFE, MC at lambda 0.3) and 1e-7 (MC at lambda 0.01); MC CV at tolerance 1e-8 against the solution at Tol::iterative(max(1e-6, 10 x gap)) (MSPE) and max(1e-5, 10 x gap) (ATT); fect's LOO MSPEs (fitted at 1e-3) and gsynth's default-tolerance ATT as cross-checks at 1e-3 and 5e-4

deviations.note: LOO over treated pre-periods (Xu 2017; fect cv.method = 'loo'); gsynth 1.4's default random folds (ife_cv_cov_r = 1 with set.seed(7)) are recorded, not pinned

deterministic folds over treated pre-period positions, warm starts along the grid and the minimum-MSPE rule; fect uses random folds and cv.rule = '1se' with time-weighted scores; the default grid is fect's and is pinned
scale-free ||X~ dbeta|| / ||Y~|| instead of gsynth's absolute ||dbeta||; pins at tolerance 1e-12

collinear or FE-absorbed covariates, r beyond the identification bound, singular treated-loading regressions and non-0/1 or reversing treatments are errors (fect: beta = 0 with a warning, r reset, NA)
seeded ChaCha8 streams per (seed, phase, replication) instead of R's RNG; pinned by replaying gsynth's own draws

methods.name: Synthetic control (Abadie, Diamond and Hainmueller 2010): unit weights as the exact simplex QP for a given V on predictors standardised as Synth; Synth's regression-based V start
methods.reference: the QP itself on Synth-standardised predictors, solved by quadprog::solve.QP with a KKT polish; Synth 1.1.10's standardisation and SV2 start written out and checked against Synth's source (validation/r/cases/causal_synth_scpi.R)
quantities: unit weights (equal, custom V; predictors x 1, x 1e4, x2 alone x 1e4)
methods.tolerance: n = 14 pre-periods: validation/README.md (weights, effects 1e-6; loss, MSPE 1e-5 relative)

deviations.note: no R reference for the Nelder-Mead search itself (Synth uses optimx and ipop): property tests only (unit invariance at x 8192, two starts, loss not above the equal-V fit); the SV2 start is pinned

deviations.quantity: unit weights on a face of optima
deviations.note: the minimum-norm weights of the 1e-10 ridge (SIMPLEX_QP_RIDGE) are reported with a warning; Synth's ipop returns an interior point of the face

methods.name: Synthetic control with prediction intervals (p2a's construction, not CFT 2021): simplex weights, variance components, t intervals
methods.reference: p2a's formulas written out in validation/r/cases/causal_synth_scpi.R (quadprog for the weights, stats::qt); scpi not installed
quantities: gaussian, subgaussian, LOO and 5-fold out-of-sample variance
methods.tolerance: n = 14: validation/README.md (weights, effects 1e-6; variances, bounds 1e-5 relative); critical values 1e-10 relative (t_quantile)

deviations.note: p2a's sqrt(in + out) interval is pinned to its own formula; it is not the Cattaneo-Feng-Titiunik construction (open, Tier 4)
